thread:
alex: kicking off release-2026-03-23a for runtime-api v3.2.1. change: model-route v4 + LRU cache tuning. rollout style = attenuation (regional pinflow).

release-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-23a runtime-api v3.2.1 - started by alex

alex: TL;DR plan:
- deploy with flag ff.runtime.route_v4 at `shadow` (0%)
- post-deploy ramp sequence: 1% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% (2m soak each)
- safety gates: p95 delta <= +150ms, error-rate delta <= +0.5% absolute
- regional drain if a region breaches gate for >90s; full rollback if global errors > +0.8% for 60s

priya: watching metrics. I'll enable the route heatmap alert and keep auto-escalation on for the first 20m after 30% step.

lee: infra prep: pin old binary on us-west groups for 1h post-deploy so we can flip quickly if needed. running pin now:
```
# pin runtime-api on us-west pool
ssh infra@ops-usw "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-api v3.2.0 --pool=us-west"
```

release-bot: deployment step: containers healthy, readiness ok, canary checks passed.

alex: setting ff.runtime.route_v4 to 1%: `flags set ff.runtime.route_v4 1 --release=release-2026-03-23a`

priya: 1% soak -> p95 +8ms, errors unchanged. heatmap shows new-route sessions starting to warm caches. tail logs:
```
[2026-03-23T09:07:10Z] cache: priming v4 keyspace chunk 1/6
[2026-03-23T09:07:27Z] routing: new-route handshake OK
```

lee: moving to 10% in 30s unless any flags.

alex: bumping to 10% now. `flags set ff.runtime.route_v4 10`

release-bot: flag update: ff.runtime.route_v4 -> 10%

priya: 45s into 10% soak: global OK, but ap-southeast (ap-sg) p95 trending +210ms (breach). digging in with region filter.

lee: can confirm increased tail in ap-sg correlates with backend cold-start logs. suggests region-specific warmup needed.

alex: decision: perform regional attenuation for ap-sg (drain new-route there to 0%) and continue global ramp elsewhere. @lee please pin ap-sg to old route for 2h.

lee: running regional flag and pin:
`flags set ff.runtime.route_v4 --region=ap-southeast-1 0 --release=release-2026-03-23a`

```
# pin ap-sg old binary
ssh infra@ops-ap "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-api v3.2.0 --pool=ap-southeast-1 --ttl=2h"
```

release-bot: regional flag update: ap-southeast-1 ff.runtime.route_v4 -> 0%

priya: after drain ap-sg p95 returned to baseline, global p95 within gate. continuing to 30% outside ap-sg.

alex: setting ff.runtime.route_v4 30 --exclude-region=ap-southeast-1

release-bot: flag update: ff.runtime.route_v4 -> 30% (ap-southeast excluded)

priya: 30% soak looks clean. autoscaler scaled a couple instances in eu-west briefly but no OOMs. errors steady.

alex: final step: promote to 100% globally except ap-sg which stays on old route until warmup completed tomorrow window. `flags set ff.runtime.route_v4 100 --exclude-region=ap-southeast-1`

release-bot: flag update: ff.runtime.route_v4 -> 100% (excluded ap-southeast-1)

nina: release note snippet for support: "runtime-api v3.2.1 rolled out with attenuation flag ff.runtime.route_v4. ap-southeast retained v3.2.0 due to regional cache warmup; manual regional pin applied. No customer-facing errors observed."

priya: filed PD incident: INC-2026-341, severity: minor, resolution: regional attenuation + pin, monitoring extended.

lee: unpin plan: `runtimectl unpin runtime-api --pool=ap-southeast-1` after additional warmup window tomorrow morning.

alex: action items to capture in GH release: add region-specific warmup step, add route-specific tail alerts, document pin/unpin playbook.

nina: noted, will add support blurb and small FAQ about "attenuation" vs "canary" language.

priya: marking thread resolved after unpin. great coordination, team. :white_check_mark:
